name: ml-researcher-os
description: Agent skills and workflows for reproducible ML research.

skills.name: paper-claim-extractor
skills.purpose: Extract paper claims, assumptions, evidence, metrics, and limitations.

skills.name: experiment-planner
skills.purpose: Turn research claims into controlled experiment plans.

skills.name: training-loop-debugger
skills.purpose: Review training and evaluation loops for common ML errors.

skills.name: result-reporter
skills.purpose: Write honest reports that separate observed results from inference.

skills.name: reproducibility-auditor
skills.purpose: Audit ML projects for reproducibility gaps.

skills.name: hf-release-prep
skills.purpose: Prepare Hugging Face model, dataset, or Space release artifacts.
